cases.label: average classwise contingency F1
cases.rationale: Independently calculates each class F1 from membership counts and averages equally over the observed class union.
cases.code:
classes = np.union1d(df.actual, df.predicted)
class_f1 = []
for label in classes:
    actual_class = df.actual.eq(label)
    predicted_class = df.predicted.eq(label)
    numerator = 2 * np.count_nonzero(actual_class & predicted_class)
    denominator = np.count_nonzero(actual_class) + np.count_nonzero(predicted_class)
    class_f1.append(numerator / denominator)
answer = float(np.mean(class_f1))
